operators.description:
zh zh ExtractSmilesFromText 用于从 OCR 文本中抽取或解析化学分子的 SMILES 表达式。算子会根据给定的提示模板（prompt_template），结合文本内容和（可选的）单体缩写信息，调用大语言模型完成解析与结构化，并将结果以 JSON 格式写回到指定列。

输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM 服务对象，需实现 LLMServingABC 接口
- prompt_template：提示词模板对象，用于构造模型输入
- input_content_key： OCR 文本的列名（默认 'text'）
- input_abbreviation_key：包含缩写/单体信息的列名（默认 'abbreviations'），可为空
- output_key：写回抽取结果的列名（默认 'synth_smiles'）

输出参数：
- DataFrame，其中 output_key 列为模型返回并经 JSON 解析后的 SMILES 结构
- 返回 output_key，供后续算子引用

备注：
- 模型输出会尝试解析为 JSON；若解析失败，将返回 [] 并记录失败次数。 en ExtractSmilesFromText is designed to extract or parse chemical SMILES expressions from OCR text. It uses a given prompt_template to construct model inputs, combining text content and optional abbreviation/monomer information, then calls the LLM to produce structured outputs which are parsed into JSON.

Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC
- prompt_template: Prompt template object used to build model input
- input_content_key: Column name containing OCR text (default 'text')
- input_abbreviation_key: Column name containing abbreviations/monomer info (default 'abbreviations'); optional
- output_key: Column name to store extracted results (default 'synth_smiles')

Output:
- DataFrame with output_key column containing JSON-parsed SMILES structures
- Returns output_key for downstream operators

Notes:
- The operator attempts to parse model outputs as JSON; failures return [] and are counted. ExtractSmilesFromText extracts chemical SMILES expressions from OCR text using an LLM.

zh zh 对对话样本进行打分评估：使用 LLM 服务根据预设评分提示词对每条对话进行评分，并将结果写回数据流。
输入参数：

- input_conversation_key：DataFrame 中对话内容字段名，默认 'conversations'

- 读取存储中的 DataFrame
- 将每条对话重组为评分提示词并调用 LLM 生成评分（JSON）
- 解析 JSON，提取 'score' 字段写入 DataFrame；解析失败则回退为 0
输出参数：
- 包含评分结果列的 DataFrame
- 包含输出字段名的列表（仅 'score' 或自定义的输出列名） en Evaluate conversation samples with an LLM-based scorer: the operator formats each conversation into a scoring prompt, calls the LLM, parses the JSON response, and writes the score back.
Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC
- input_conversation_key: column name for conversations in the DataFrame, default 'conversations'
- output_score_key: column name for the score output, default 'score'
Process:
- Read the DataFrame from storage
- Reformat each conversation into a scoring prompt and call the LLM (expects JSON)
- Parse the JSON to extract 'score'; fallback to 0 on parse errors
Output:
- DataFrame with a score column added
- A list containing the output field name (e.g., 'score') Evaluate conversation samples with an LLM-based scorer and write the parsed 'score' back to the DataFrame.

operators.description:
zh zh 该算子用于统一 Bench 评测，支持多种任务范式并将评测结果写回 DataFrame，同时输出整体统计到 eval_result_path。

支持类型与默认 metric：
- key1_text_score：ppl
- key2_qa：math_verify（或 use_semantic_judge=True 时 semantic_judge）
- key2_q_ma：any_math_verify（多参考）
- key3_q_choices_a：ll_choice_acc（基于 loglikelihood；无 serving 接口时使用 HF forward 计算 ll）
- key3_q_choices_as：micro_f1（解析多选集合后计算）
- key3_q_a_rejected：pairwise_ll_winrate（基于 ll 比较 better vs rejected）

初始化参数：
- eval_result_path：统计结果落盘路径
- eval_type：评测类型（同上）
- llm_serving：可选；用于 semantic_judge 或提供模型路径信息以进行 PPL/LL 的 HF 计算
- prompt_template：提示模板对象（可选；需提供 build_prompt；默认使用 AnswerJudgePrompt）
- system_prompt：语义评测/judge 的系统提示词
- metric_type：可选；不传则使用 eval_type 的默认 metric
- use_semantic_judge：仅对 key2_qa 有效；是否使用语义评测

运行参数：
- storage：DataFlowStorage
- input_text_key：文本列名（key1_text_score）
- input_question_key：问题列名（key2/key3）
- input_target_key：单个参考答案列名（key2_qa）
- input_targets_key：多个参考答案列名（key2_q_ma）
- input_choices_key：选项列名（key3_q_choices_a/key3_q_choices_as）
- input_label_key：单个标签列名（key3_q_choices_a）
- input_labels_key：多个标签列名（key3_q_choices_as）
- input_better_key：优选答案列名（key3_q_a_rejected）
- input_rejected_key：劣选答案列名（key3_q_a_rejected）
- input_context_key：可选，上下文字段名
- input_pred_key：预测答案字段名（默认 generated_ans）

输出：
- output_eval_score_key（数值分数）
- output_eval_pred_key（解析后的预测）
- output_eval_valid_key（是否有效）
- output_eval_error_key（错误信息）
- 保存统计：total_samples/valid_samples/accuracy 或 ppl_mean 等到 eval_result_path
- 返回本次评测涉及/产出的列名列表 This operator evaluates unified bench datasets across multiple task archetypes. It writes per-sample results back to the dataframe and saves aggregated statistics to eval_result_path.

Supported Types (default metric):
- key1_text_score (ppl)
- key2_qa (math_verify or semantic_judge)
- key2_q_ma (any_math_verify)
- key3_q_choices_a (ll_choice_acc)
- key3_q_choices_as (micro_f1)
- key3_q_a_rejected (pairwise_ll_winrate)

Input Parameters:
- eval_result_path: Path to save aggregated statistics
- eval_type: Evaluation type (one of the supported types)
- llm_serving: Optional; required for semantic_judge and used as model source for HF-based PPL/LL computation
- prompt_template: Prompt template object (optional; must provide build_prompt; default is AnswerJudgePrompt)
- system_prompt: System prompt for semantic judging
- metric_type: Optional; overrides the default metric for the given eval_type
- use_semantic_judge: Only for key2_qa; whether to use LLM-based semantic judging

Run Parameters:
- storage: DataFlowStorage
- input_text_key: Text column name (key1_text_score)
- input_question_key: Question column name (key2/key3)
- input_target_key: Single reference answer column name (key2_qa)
- input_targets_key: Multiple reference answers column name (key2_q_ma)
- input_choices_key: Choices column name (key3_q_choices_a/key3_q_choices_as)
- input_label_key: Single label column name (key3_q_choices_a)
- input_labels_key: Multiple labels column name (key3_q_choices_as)
- input_better_key: Better answer column name (key3_q_a_rejected)
- input_rejected_key: Rejected answer column name (key3_q_a_rejected)
- input_context_key: Optional context column name
- input_pred_key: Prediction column name (default: generated_ans)

Output Parameters:
- output_eval_score_key: Numeric score (accuracy classes use 0/1)
- output_eval_pred_key: Parsed prediction
- output_eval_valid_key: Whether the sample is valid
- output_eval_error_key: Error message if any
- Saves aggregated stats to eval_result_path
- Returns a list of involved/output keys

zh zh 该算子支持通过多个自定义函数对 DataFrame 进行灵活过滤。

输入参数：
- filter_rules：一个函数列表，每个函数形式为 lambda df: ...，需返回一个与 df 长度一致的布尔 Series。所有规则之间采用与（AND）关系组合。

示例：
  - lambda df: df['score'] > 0.5
  - lambda df: df['label'].isin(['A', 'B']) en This operator applies custom filtering functions to a DataFrame.

Each filter rule is a function (e.g., lambda expression) that takes a DataFrame and returns a boolean Series indicating which rows to retain.

Input Parameters:
- filter_rules: A list of functions, each in the form of lambda df: ..., returning a boolean Series of the same length as the DataFrame. All rules are combined using logical AND.

Examples:
  - lambda df: df['score'] > 0.5
  - lambda df: df['label'].isin(['A', 'B']) GeneralFilter filters DataFrame rows using a list of functions returning boolean Series.

Input Parameters:
- input_key: Field name containing the document content (default: 'content').
- embedding_serving: Instance of embedding serving for text-to-vector conversion.
- num_samples: The target number of document fragments to select.

Output:
- A filtered dataset containing only the selected representative document fragments. KCenterGreedyFilter selects representative document fragments using a greedy coreset strategy.

operators.description:
zh zh PromptedFilter 使用内置的 PromptedEvaluator 对输入数据进行数值化打分，并根据指定的分数区间（min_score 到 max_score，闭区间）筛选出符合条件的样本。默认情况下打分范围是 1–5，但用户可以通过 system_prompt 自定义其他评分规则。

输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM 服务对象，需实现 LLMServingABC 接口
- system_prompt：系统提示词，定义评估规范（可选，默认 'Please evaluate the quality of this data on a scale from 1 to 5.'）
- input_key：待评估文本所在列名（默认 'raw_content'）
- output_key：写回打分结果的列名（默认 'eval'，若已存在将被覆盖）
- min_score：筛选的最小分（默认 5）
- max_score：筛选的最大分（默认 5）

输出参数：
- 过滤后的 DataFrame（仅保留分数位于 [min_score, max_score] 的行）
- 返回 output_key 以供后续算子引用

备注：
- 默认打分区间是 1–5，但可根据实际 prompt 改变。 en PromptedFilter leverages PromptedEvaluator to assign numeric scores to input data, and filters rows whose scores fall within [min_score, max_score] (inclusive). By default, the scoring scale is 1–5, but this can be customized through system_prompt.

Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC
- system_prompt: System prompt defining the evaluation criteria (default: 'Please evaluate the quality of this data on a scale from 1 to 5.')
- input_key: Column name containing the text to evaluate (default 'raw_content')
- output_key: Column name to store the score (default 'eval'; overwritten if it exists)
- min_score: Minimum score for filtering (default 5)
- max_score: Maximum score for filtering (default 5)

Output:
- Filtered DataFrame (rows with scores in [min_score, max_score])
- Returns output_key for downstream operators

Note:
- Default scoring range is 1–5, but can vary depending on the system_prompt. PromptedFilter scores rows via PromptedEvaluator and filters by a configurable score range (default 1–5).

zh zh 基于提示词的生成算子，支持长文本自动分chunk。采用递归二分方式进行chunk切分，确保每段不超过max_chunk_len tokens。从给定的输入文件路径读取内容，生成结果保存至指定输出文件路径。多个生成结果以separator拼接成最终输出字符串。输入参数：

zh zh RandomDomainKnowledgeRowGenerator算子用于结合提示模板(prompt_template)与LLM服务对象(llm_serving)，批量生成与指定领域相关的文本内容。

功能说明：
- 结合SFTFromScratchGeneratorPrompt模板，根据domain_keys随机选择领域并生成内容；
- 当输入DataFrame为空时，可通过generation_num参数控制生成样本数量；
- 生成的文本结果将写入指定字段(output_key)，并返回该字段名供后续算子使用。

参数说明：

- prompt_template：提示模板实例，需为SFTFromScratchGeneratorPrompt类型；
- storage：DataFlowStorage对象，用于读取与写入数据；
- output_key：生成结果写入的字段名，默认为'generated_content'；
- generation_num：生成内容数量，默认为1；
- domain_keys：指定或限制生成内容所属领域。

输出说明：
- 返回值：输出字段名(output_key)，供后续算子引用；
- 同时将包含生成内容的新DataFrame写回至存储。 en The RandomDomainKnowledgeRowGenerator operator generates domain-related text content by combining a prompt template (prompt_template) with an LLM serving instance (llm_serving).

Function Description:
- Utilizes the SFTFromScratchGeneratorPrompt template to randomly select domains via domain_keys;
- Supports content generation when no input DataFrame is available, controlled by generation_num;
- Generated text is written to the specified output field (output_key), and the field name is returned.

Parameter Description:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing the LLMServingABC interface;
- prompt_template: Prompt template instance of type SFTFromScratchGeneratorPrompt;
- storage: DataFlowStorage object used for reading and writing data;
- output_key: Name of the field to write generated results (default: 'generated_content');
- generation_num: Number of contents to generate when there is no input data (default: 1);
- domain_keys: Domain key(s) specifying or constraining the generation domain; empty string for random.

Output Description:
- Returns the output field name (output_key) for downstream reference;
- Writes the DataFrame containing generated content back to storage. RandomDomainKnowledgeRowGenerator算子用于结合提示模板(prompt_template)与LLM服务对象(llm_serving)，批量生成领域文本内容。

支持多字段组合作为去重依据，可有效去除内容相似但表述不同的重复数据，提高数据集多样性。
输入参数：
- eps：相似度阈值，值越小表示允许的相似度越低，默认为0.05（即余弦相似度大于0.95视为重复）
- model_name：预训练模型名称，默认为'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
- model_cache_dir：模型缓存目录，默认为'./dataflow_cache'
- device：模型运行设备，默认为'cuda'
- input_keys：多个输入字段名列表，与input_key二选一
- input_key：单个输入字段名，与input_keys二选一
- output_key：去重结果字段名，默认为'minhash_deduplicated_label'
输出参数：
- 过滤后的DataFrame，仅保留语义不重复的样本（标记为1的样本）
- 返回包含去重结果字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Identify semantically duplicate text using BERT embeddings for near deduplication. Calculate cosine similarity between text embedding vectors to detect semantically similar texts and retain unique samples.
Supports multiple field combinations as deduplication criteria, effectively removing duplicate data with similar content but different expressions to improve dataset diversity.
Input Parameters:
- eps: Similarity threshold, smaller values allow lower similarity, default is 0.05 (cosine similarity > 0.95 is considered duplicate)
- model_name: Pretrained model name, default is 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
- model_cache_dir: Model cache directory, default is './dataflow_cache'
- device: Model running device, default is 'cuda'
- input_keys: List of multiple input field names, alternative to input_key
- input_key: Single input field name, alternative to input_keys
- output_key: Deduplication result field name, default is 'minhash_deduplicated_label'
Output Parameters:
- Filtered DataFrame containing only semantically unique samples (samples marked as 1)
- List containing deduplication result field name for subsequent operator reference Near deduplication by identifying semantically similar content using BERT embeddings.
operators.name: SemDeduplicateFilter

operators.description:
zh zh 使用SimHash算法通过汉明距离识别相似文本，执行近似去重操作。将文本转换为固定长度的指纹，通过计算指纹间的汉明距离判断文本相似度。
相比语义去重速度更快，适合大规模数据集的快速去重预处理，尤其适用于检测字符层面相似的文本。
输入参数：
- fingerprint_size：指纹长度，默认为64位
- bound：相似度阈值，值越小表示允许的相似度越低，默认为0.1（即相似度大于0.9视为重复）
- input_keys：多个输入字段名列表，与input_key二选一
- input_key：单个输入字段名，与input_keys二选一
- output_key：去重结果字段名，默认为'minhash_deduplicated_label'
输出参数：
- 过滤后的DataFrame，仅保留相似性低于阈值的唯一样本（标记为1的样本）
- 返回包含去重结果字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Detect similar text via SimHash algorithm and Hamming distance for near deduplication. Convert text to fixed-length fingerprints and determine text similarity by calculating Hamming distance between fingerprints.
Faster than semantic deduplication, suitable for fast deduplication preprocessing of large-scale datasets, especially for detecting character-level similar texts.
Input Parameters:
- fingerprint_size: Fingerprint length, default is 64 bits
- bound: Similarity threshold, smaller values allow lower similarity, default is 0.1 (similarity > 0.9 is considered duplicate)
- input_keys: List of multiple input field names, alternative to input_key
- input_key: Single input field name, alternative to input_keys
- output_key: Deduplication result field name, default is 'minhash_deduplicated_label'
Output Parameters:
- Filtered DataFrame containing only unique samples with similarity below threshold (samples marked as 1)
- List containing deduplication result field name for subsequent operator reference Near deduplication by detecting text similarity using SimHash algorithm and Hamming distance.
operators.name: SimHashDeduplicateFilter

Input Parameters:
- max_edit_distance: Maximum edit distance, default is 2

- text: Text string to be evaluated
Output parameters:
- float: Educational value score between 0 and 1, higher values indicate greater educational value

operators.description:
zh zh 通过LLM评估文本的多个元属性，包括文本结构、多样性与复杂性、流畅性与可理解性、安全性、教育价值以及内容准确性与有效性。
输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM服务对象，需实现LLMServingABC接口
- dimensions：评估维度列表，每个维度对应的字典中包含dimension_name，description，和示例字段：
   * dimension_name：维度名称
   * description：维度的描述
   * example_list：包含示例文本和得分的列表
- input_key：输入文本字段名
输出参数：
- 包含6个评估维度得分的DataFrame，列名为：Text Structure, Diversity & Complexity, Fluency & Understandability, Safety, Educational Value, Content Accuracy & Effectiveness en Evaluate multiple meta attributes of text using LLM, including Text Structure, Diversity & Complexity, Fluency & Understandability, Safety, Educational Value, and Content Accuracy & Effectiveness.
Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC interface
- dimensions: List of evaluation dimensions, each dimension corresponding to a dictionary containing dimension_name, description, and example field:
   * dimension_name: Name of the dimension
   * description: Description of the dimension
   * example_list: List containing example texts and scores
- input_key: Field name for input text
Output Parameters:
- DataFrame containing scores for 6 evaluation dimensions with columns: Text Structure, Diversity & Complexity, Fluency & Understandability, Safety, Educational Value, Content Accuracy & Effectiveness Evaluate multiple meta attributes of text using LLM.
operators.name: MetaSampleEvaluator

operators.description:
zh zh 基于BGE模型和GPT成对比较数据训练的文本质量评分器，支持中英文输入。通过对文本进行单样本评估，返回0-1之间的质量分数，分数越高表示文本质量越好。模型分为英文版本(zks2856/PairQual-Scorer-en)和中文版本(zks2856/PairQual-Scorer-zh)。

- text: 待评估的文本字符串
- lang: 语言类型，可选'en'或'zh'

- float: 0-1之间的质量分数，越高表示质量越好 Text quality scorer trained on BGE model and GPT pairwise comparison data, supporting bilingual input. Evaluate text through single-sample assessment, returning a quality score between 0 and 1, where higher scores indicate better text quality. Models include English version (zks2856/PairQual-Scorer-en) and Chinese version (zks2856/PairQual-Scorer-zh).
Input parameters:
- text: Text string to be evaluated
- lang: Language type, optional 'en' or 'zh'
Output parameters:
- float: Quality score between 0 and 1, higher values indicate better quality

奖励模型能够评估文本的相关性、有用性、无害性等人类偏好指标，可用于筛选符合人类价值观的高质量文本。
输入参数：
- min_score：保留样本的最小奖励分数阈值，默认为0.2
- max_score：保留样本的最大奖励分数阈值，默认为0.8
- device：模型运行设备，默认为'cuda'
- model_cache_dir：模型缓存目录，默认为'./dataflow_cache'
- input_instruction_key：指令字段名，默认为'instruction'
- input_output_key：输出字段名，默认为'output'
输出参数：
- 过滤后的DataFrame，仅保留奖励分数在[min_score, max_score]范围内的样本
- 返回包含奖励分数字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Filter data using scores from the RMScorer. Quality scoring using reward model trained with human preference data, where higher scores indicate better quality.
Reward model evaluates human preference metrics such as relevance, helpfulness, and harmlessness, useful for filtering high-quality text aligned with human values.
Input Parameters:
- min_score: Minimum reward score threshold for retaining samples, default is 0.2
- max_score: Maximum reward score threshold for retaining samples, default is 0.8
- device: Model running device, default is 'cuda'
- model_cache_dir: Model cache directory, default is './dataflow_cache'
- input_instruction_key: Instruction field name, default is 'instruction'
- input_output_key: Output field name, default is 'output'
Output Parameters:
- Filtered DataFrame containing only samples with reward scores within [min_score, max_score] range
- List containing reward score field name for subsequent operator reference Filter data based on quality scores from human preference-trained reward model.
operators.name: RMFilter

operators.description:
zh zh 使用Superfiltering评分器过滤掉低质量数据。基于GPT-2模型计算困惑度比值来评估指令跟随难度，比值越低表示指令越容易被模型理解和执行。
适用于筛选适合特定模型能力的指令数据，提高模型训练效率和效果。
输入参数：
- min_score：保留样本的最小分数阈值，默认为0.0
- max_score：保留样本的最大分数阈值，默认为1.0
- device：模型运行设备，默认为'cuda'
- model_cache_dir：模型缓存目录，默认为'./dataflow_cache'
- max_length：文本最大长度，默认为512
- input_instruction_key：指令字段名，默认为'instruction'
- input_input_key：输入字段名，默认为'input'
- input_output_key：输出字段名，默认为'output'
- output_key：过滤结果分数字段名，默认为'SuperfilteringScore'
输出参数：
- 过滤后的DataFrame，仅保留分数在[min_score, max_score]范围内的样本
- 返回包含过滤结果分数字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Filter out low-quality data using the Superfiltering scorer. Evaluate instruction following difficulty by calculating perplexity ratio with GPT-2 model; lower ratios indicate instructions are easier for models to understand and execute.
Suitable for selecting instruction data appropriate for specific model capabilities, improving model training efficiency and effectiveness.
Input Parameters:
- min_score: Minimum score threshold for retaining samples, default is 0.0
- max_score: Maximum score threshold for retaining samples, default is 1.0
- device: Model running device, default is 'cuda'
- model_cache_dir: Model cache directory, default is './dataflow_cache'
- max_length: Maximum text length, default is 512
- input_instruction_key: Instruction field name, default is 'instruction'
- input_input_key: Input field name, default is 'input'
- input_output_key: Output field name, default is 'output'
- output_key: Filter result score field name, default is 'SuperfilteringScore'
Output Parameters:
- Filtered DataFrame containing only samples with scores within [min_score, max_score] range
- List containing filter result score field name for subsequent operator reference Filter low-quality data using perplexity ratio calculated with GPT-2 model.
operators.name: SuperfilteringFilter

operators.description:
zh zh 基于TreeinstructScore打分器的得分对数据进行过滤。通过生成语法树的节点数来衡量指令复杂性，节点越多表示指令越复杂。
适用于筛选特定复杂度范围内的指令数据，平衡数据集难度分布，优化模型训练效果。
输入参数：
- min_score：保留样本的最小语法树节点数阈值，默认为7
- max_score：保留样本的最大语法树节点数阈值，默认为100
- llm_serving：LLM服务对象，需实现LLMServingABC接口
- input_key：输入指令字段名
- output_key：语法树节点数字段名，默认为'TreeinstructScore'
输出参数：
- 过滤后的DataFrame，仅保留语法树节点数在[min_score, max_score]范围内的样本
- 返回包含语法树节点数字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Filter data using scores from the TreeinstructScore. Measure instruction complexity by the number of nodes in the generated syntax tree; more nodes indicate more complex instructions.
Suitable for selecting instruction data within specific complexity ranges, balancing dataset difficulty distribution and optimizing model training effectiveness.
Input Parameters:
- min_score: Minimum syntax tree node count threshold for retaining samples, default is 7
- max_score: Maximum syntax tree node count threshold for retaining samples, default is 100
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC interface
- input_key: Input instruction field name
- output_key: Syntax tree node count field name, default is 'TreeinstructScore'
Output Parameters:
- Filtered DataFrame containing only samples with syntax tree node count within [min_score, max_score] range
- List containing syntax tree node count field name for subsequent operator reference Filter data based on instruction complexity measured by syntax tree node count.
operators.name: TreeinstructFilter

operators.description:
zh zh 基于预置知识树标签，两阶段从0合成SFT格式数据（合成数量大于5000时建议增加标签数量）。第一阶段生成不同难度级别的问题，第二阶段为每个问题生成对应的答案。输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM服务对象，需实现LLMServingABC接口
- num_samples：生成样本总数，建议小于5000，默认值为15
- prompt_template：提示词模板对象，用于定义提示结构
输出参数：
- 包含'difficulty'、'instruction'和'output'字段的DataFrame
- 返回生成的DataFrame用于后续处理 en Two-stage generation of SFT-style data from scratch based on predefined knowledge tree tags (for over 5000 samples, consider increasing the number of tags). 
First stage generates questions of varying difficulty levels, second stage generates answers for each question.
Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC interface
- num_samples: Total number of samples to generate, recommended to be less than 5000, default is 15

- prompt_template: Prompt template object, for defining the prompt structure
Output Parameters:
- DataFrame containing 'difficulty', 'instruction', and 'output' fields
- Returns generated DataFrame for subsequent processing CondorGenerator generates SFT-style data through two-stage LLM generation based on predefined knowledge tree tags.
operators.name: CondorGenerator

operators.description:
zh zh 基于给定文档内容，生成监督微调格式的问答数据。并支持用户自定义生成内容要求。从原始文档中提取信息，生成符合SFT格式的指令-响应对。输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM服务对象，需实现LLMServingABC接口
- custom_prompt：用户自定义提示词
- input_key：输入文档内容字段名，默认为'raw_content'
- max_tokens：生成文本的最大token数，默认为4096
输出参数：
- 包含'instruction'、'output'和'raw_content'字段的DataFrame
- 返回包含'instruction'和'output'字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Generate supervised fine-tuning format Q&A data based on the given document content and support user-defined content generation requirements. 
Extracts information from raw documents to generate instruction-response pairs in SFT format.
Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC interface
- custom_prompt: User-defined custom prompt
- input_key: Field name for input document content, default is 'raw_content'
- max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens for generated text, default is 4096

Output Parameters:
- DataFrame containing 'instruction', 'output', and 'raw_content' fields
- List containing 'instruction' and 'output' field names for subsequent operator reference SFTGeneratorSeed generates SFT format Q&A data from document content with custom prompt support.
operators.name: SFTGeneratorSeed

operators.description:
zh zh 两阶段优化指令回复质量：第一阶段调用API生成对回复的评论，第二阶段利用评论调用API改写回复，提升指令对质量。通过迭代优化提高问答对的整体质量。输入参数：
- llm_serving：LLM服务对象，需实现LLMServingABC接口
- input_instruction_key：输入指令字段名，默认为'instruction'
- input_output_key：输入回复字段名，默认为'output'
- prompt_template：提示词模板对象，用于定义提示结构
输出参数：
- 包含优化后回复的DataFrame
- 返回包含优化后回复字段名的列表，用于后续算子引用 en Two-stage optimization of instruction-response quality: First stage calls API to generate critique on responses, 
second stage uses critique to call API to refine responses, improving the quality of QA pairs through iterative optimization.
Input Parameters:
- llm_serving: LLM serving object implementing LLMServingABC interface
- input_instruction_key: Field name for input instructions, default is 'instruction'
- input_output_key: Field name for input responses, default is 'output'
- prompt_template: Prompt template object, for defining the prompt structure
Output Parameters:
- DataFrame containing refined responses
- List containing refined response field name for subsequent operator reference CondorRefiner improves QA pair quality through two-stage critique and refinement process.
operators.name: CondorRefiner
